# Assured Arc Frontend and Accessibility

## Capability

Builds usable, responsive, accessible interfaces that match the existing design system and framework.

## Workflow

1. Inspect existing components, tokens, layout, state, and testing patterns.
2. Define the user task, interaction states, keyboard path, and loading or error behavior.
3. Prefer semantic HTML and native controls before custom ARIA behavior.
4. Ensure focus visibility, labels, contrast, responsive layout, and reduced motion support.
5. Validate keyboard behavior, screen-size boundaries, and relevant component tests.

## Practical application

Use for forms, dashboards, navigation, reusable components, mobile layouts, and interaction polish.

## Prerequisites

Existing frontend stack, design tokens or styles, target browsers, and accessibility requirements.

## Measurable benefit

Reduces usability defects and rework while expanding support for keyboard and assistive technology users.
